focus_areas: Specular reflections on the steel surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the blade's reflection. Real steel often has uneven polishing marks or micro-scratches. If the reflection is too perfect or 'smudged', it indicates AI generation. Also, verify the handle material texture; AI often struggles with realistic wood grain on small objects like knife handles.
